findings.regressions: Four deferred-cursor races failed before fix; all45ObjectExplorer focused tests pass.
Split lifecycle regressions failed before fix; all30controller tests pass.
Multi-class split origin, independent restore slots, migration, group renumbering, ambiguity and native focus regressions failed before the additional fix; all 37 controller tests pass.
Three no-argument palette regressions failed before fix. Native palette cancel/retry selects the exact schema/project source without creating an extra tab.
Three retained retry diagnostic regressions failed before fix; superseded replies remain isolated. Native failed-read -> First retry -> navigate away -> Back retains success.

Reviewed multi-class splitting uses native complete-file contents, preserves source metadata/BOM/EOL and rejects unsupported, dirty/stale/colliding inputs. Concurrent edit and resource-ordering regressions were red before safeguards. Actual native Undo/Redo, Save All and LF under CRLF preference passed.

Off-page and filter-excluded selection failed with the real model before the fix. Requested IDs are resolved against staged model input before updating selection; unknown/failed lookups retain the prior state and binding. Delayed selection/draft/removal notices cannot overwrite newer navigation. Nine selection regressions and 51 workspace/model tests pass. Actual native Preview Member outside the page and filter keeps the bounded member rail and source bytes unchanged.

Eight LF/CRLF comment-closing/declaration partition cases failed before the guard. Existing lexer exclusion ranges now reject every unsafe raw class/section/mapping slice before edits; whole comments remain unchanged. Twenty splitter and eleven split-offer tests pass, including zero native edits for unsafe input.

Held editor preparation plus unrelated search/filter/refresh/rejected lookup reproduced stale source before the fix. Catalogue lookup revisions now cancel only unresolved model reads; a validated selection owns its editor across unrelated refreshes. Committed off-page metadata publication and rejected/valid successor matrices also pass. Eighteen selection regressions and 99 combined workspace/model/controller tests passed; actual native recovery persistence held during a filter change then resumed with the correct selected member code and unchanged source.

Registered ObjectExplorer history payload regressions reproduced 2.6 MB and 10.4 MB serialized history at 25/100 retained large objects. Dropdown messages now carry only native oid/schema/className, reducing fixture history to 1.4 KB/5.4 KB while complete native snapshots and Back/Forward view state remain extension-side. Four new history payload tests and all 53 ObjectExplorer tests pass.
